LanguageData.ASE_BerserkerProtocol.label: berserker protocol
LanguageData.ASE_BerserkerProtocol.description: A protocol created for public entertainment: the more damaged the android is, the more ferociously it fights. Very popular in underground arenas.
LanguageData.ASE_BerserkerProtocol.customEffectDescri: Increases damage when injured. Effect starts at <80% HP
LanguageData.ASE_BerserkerProtocol_T2.label: berserker protocol T2
LanguageData.ASE_BerserkerProtocol_T2.description: Further development of the protocol created for public entertainment: the more damaged the android is, the more ferociously it fights. Due to imperfect technology, it may enter uncontrollable rage and become a threat to everything living within 1 kilometer (including your colonists).
LanguageData.ASE_BerserkerProtocol_T2.customEffectDes: Each 1% of missing health increases melee attack speed by 2%
LanguageData.ASE_SniperOptics.label: sniper optics
LanguageData.ASE_SniperOptics.description: Improved optics significantly increase weapon range, but the android itself becomes extremely vulnerable.
LanguageData.ASE_TitanFist.label: titan fist
LanguageData.ASE_TitanFist.description: The android strikes much slower, but puts all its power into each blow.
LanguageData.ASE_UnarmoredEvasion.label: unarmored evasion
LanguageData.ASE_UnarmoredEvasion.description: Thanks to additional servos, the android dodges melee attacks more easily. The fewer items worn by the android, the more effective.
LanguageData.ASE_UnarmoredEvasion.customEffectDescrip: +15 melee & ranged dodge chance per empty apparel slot
LanguageData.ASE_ScrapWarrior.label: scrap warrior
LanguageData.ASE_ScrapWarrior.description: Thanks to cheap materials, the android is not afraid of damage and deals increased damage. The lower the android's cost, the greater the bonus.
LanguageData.ASE_ScrapWarrior.customEffectDescription: Additional damage when android cost is less than 2000 silver, up to +50% at cost up to 250 silver
LanguageData.ASE_AutoFeedSystem.label: auto-feed system
LanguageData.ASE_AutoFeedSystem.description: Built-in hand-mounted loading system that allows the android to make up to 5 shots with instant aiming and ×5 firing speed. The system recharges over time.
LanguageData.ASE_HeatedCircuits.label: heated circuits
LanguageData.ASE_HeatedCircuits.description: The reactor's heat dissipation system is connected to the android's fists, allowing it to inflict burns with melee attacks
LanguageData.ASE_PiercingAlgorithms.label: piercing algorithms
LanguageData.ASE_PiercingAlgorithms.description: The android can find weak spots in the enemy's armor, but cannot protect its own.
LanguageData.ASE_PerfectAimProtocol.label: perfect aim protocol
LanguageData.ASE_PerfectAimProtocol.description: Improved aiming protocol forces the android to aim for an eternity, but the hit will be perfect.
LanguageData.ASE_SiegeSpecialist.label: siege specialist
LanguageData.ASE_SiegeSpecialist.description: Improved geometric calculation block allows quick and accurate mortar fire, but such androids are often equipped with minimally acceptable armor.
LanguageData.ASE_MeleeOverdrive_T1.label: melee overdrive T1
LanguageData.ASE_MeleeOverdrive_T1.description: Android created specifically for foggy and rainy biomes. Cannot use ranged weapons, but fights well in melee.
LanguageData.ASE_MeleeOverdrive_T2.label: melee overdrive T2
LanguageData.ASE_MeleeOverdrive_T2.description: Android created specifically for foggy and rainy biomes with many hostile creatures. Cannot use ranged weapons, but fights excellently in melee.
LanguageData.ASE_CryoStrikeProtocol.label: cryo-strike protocol
LanguageData.ASE_CryoStrikeProtocol.description: Refrigerant from the cooling system is redirected to the android's fists: each strike significantly cools the target.
LanguageData.ASE_CryoStrikeProtocol.customEffectDescr: Cooling strikes (with chance to apply hypothermia)
LanguageData.ASE_TacticalNetwork.label: tactical network
LanguageData.ASE_TacticalNetwork.description: Real-time tactical data exchange allows androids to fight more effectively.
LanguageData.ASE_TacticalNetwork.customEffectDescript: Per android with this gene on the map: +5% accuracy, +5% melee dodge, +5% ranged dodge, +5% melee damage
LanguageData.ASE_CombatDataLogger.label: combat data logger
LanguageData.ASE_CombatDataLogger.description: With each defeated enemy, the android accumulates vast amounts of data about its target, allowing it to become even more effective.
LanguageData.ASE_BarrageProtocol.label: barrage protocol
LanguageData.ASE_BarrageProtocol.description: The android spends less time aiming, showering the enemy with a hail of bullets, but accuracy leaves much to be desired.
